name: MeiKura ~Zokusei Morisugi Maidroid to, Maketakunai Classmate no Gohoushi Seikatsu~
original_name: メイクラ ～属性盛りすぎメイドロイドと、負けたくないクラスメイトのご奉仕性活～
source:
The protagonist, Ichinose Takuto, was living an unchanging, too ordinary everyday life.
One day, he ends up taking in a housekeeper android named “Neneko” from an acquaintance, the scientist Minegishi Erika.

A chaotic cohabitation life begins with a maidroid who is cute and incredibly handy at housework, yet for some reason is extremely proactive when it comes to sex!

And then, his childhood friend and classmate, Hasuna Saki, also crashes the scene--

The relationship among the three of them grows ever closer.
Cheerful, lively, and a little thrilling—what will happen to this chaotic sex life—!

[MTLed from the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/maidmate/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角市之濑拓人原本过着一成不变、平淡无奇的日常生活。
某一天，他从相识的科学家峰岸绘里香那里接手了一台名叫“宁宁子”的家政仿生人。

这台女仆机器人不仅外表可爱、家务万能，不知为何在性事方面更是积极主动得惊人——热闹非凡的同居生活就此拉开帷幕！

紧接着，身为青梅竹马兼同班同学的莲菜咲也强势插足进来——

三人之间的距离愈发亲密无间。
欢快热闹又略带刺激——这场鸡飞狗跳的性福日常究竟将走向何方——！

[译自[url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/maidmate/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
